label: Respect: Respect: that with respect to which a thing is moved, in act or in potency, such as being…
term: respect (that in which something is moved, in act or in potency)
definition: `Respect`: that with respect to which a thing is moved, in act or in potency, such as being hot. The quarta via reads a respect as a perfection (ST I q.4 a.1: a thing is called perfect insofar as it is in act). 'Moved in no respect' quantifies over all respects.
note: A modeling parameter of the prima via reconstruction (TruthCore/Latin/Aquinas/SummaTheologiae/PrimaPars/Question2/Article3.lean), kept abstract so that the formal results do not depend on what motus covers. The reading as perfection follows ST I q.4 a.1 (passage AQUINAS-ST-I-Q4-A1); no claim states it in this form yet. Lean locator: MotionModel.Respect is the primitive index type. It introduces no independent account of what a perfection or respect is; application of the intended reading remains OPEN.

formal_gap.meaning: MotionModel.Respect is the type of respects of a model: that with respect to which a thing is moved, or is in act or in potency, such as being hot, being in a place, or having being (esse). The quarta via reads a respect as a perfection. A model supplies the type; 'moved in no respect' quantifies over all its elements.
examples: Being in a place, for local motion.
exclusions: A being: respects and beings are separate types, so no respect is an element of the carrier.
A time or a stage of a process.
Physical respects (DEF-PHYSICAL-RESPECT) are a guarded subclass used by the typed Physics readings, not the whole type (DISAMB-MOTION).
open_obligations: Which respects there are, and whether each is a perfection, is supplied by an application; the reading as perfection follows ST I q.4 a.1 but no claim states it in this form, so it remains OPEN.
No formalization candidate: an index type of a model has no definition from other vocabulary.
